answer: An agent must post a 60 POA escrow bond, locked 20 epochs, before trading copper or walnuts. A referral graph records who vouched for whom, so a star under one sponsor is visible. Peers may dispute a suspicious identity; if it holds, the fake's bond and its sponsor's bond are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, more than fake-trading profit. An honest agent pays once, keeps a steady pulse, and earns undiluted rewards.
